summary: To create an LDAP authenticator, set LDAP Server URI (multiple allowed), LDAP Bind DN (for example cn=josie,cn=users,dc=website,dc=com), Bind Password and LDAP Group Type, which with group search assigns groups (first cn value by default, or name_attr).
questions: How do I configure LDAP authentication in AAP?
What is the LDAP Bind DN?
Can I set multiple LDAP servers?
